consensusAnalysis.marketContext: Bitcoin down 24.1% from $126K ATH to $95,628. Critical technical breakdown with 50-week MA lost for first time since bull run began. Death cross formed. Fear & Greed Index at extreme fear (10-14). ETF outflows slowing. 500+ days post-halving aligns with historical cycle top timing. Market at genuine inflection point with legitimate cases for both bull continuation and bear market beginning.
consensusAnalysis.consensusVerdict: CRITICAL DECISION POINT: Market split between bulls and bears. Breaking below $88K-$93K support would confirm bear case ($35K-$75K targets). Reclaiming $108K-$116K would invalidate bearish thesis and target $142K-$152K. Current extreme fear could be capitulation bottom (bullish) or start of prolonged bear (bearish). Next 2-4 weeks will likely determine 12-month direction.
consensusAnalysis.riskLevel: Very High - Major Technical Breakdown vs Capitulation Bottom
